title: Show Vault Explorer and search vault items by HRID
summary: Searches the items of an installed Vault by HRID pattern with IEDMS_Vault.SearchItems and lists each hit's HRID, description and creator; optionally shows a panel by name. Shows the option and flag sets and how to read the asynchronous result.
phrasings: find components in Altium 365 with a wildcard
open a panel by name from code
wait for an EDMS request result

commands.name: BrowseVault
commands.description: Show Vault Explorer and search vault items by HRID
commands.params: Hrid=<item HRID, required>|Vault=<index, default 0>|Max=<count, default 100>|Timeout=<seconds, default 30>|ShowPanel=true|false (default: true from the menu, false on the pipe)|Panel=<panel name, default Vault Explorer>
